propositions: When re-reviewing a BLOCK verdict with recorded blocking findings, a DET pre-check compares current plan material against the fingerprinted sidecar record to detect if cited evidence anchors remain verbatim and unchanged.

If all matched citation anchors are untouched since the blocking review, print a warn-only message naming the persisting findings before running the review; the warning never declines or halts the review.

Findings with unmatchable anchors (paraphrased evidence, structural findings without quotes) never trigger the warning independently; warning fires only when at least one anchor matched the old text and all matched anchors are still present.
The warning flag is recorded in sidecar metrics as `precheck.cited_anchor_warning` on every plan review (true or false) to enable offline measurement of warning hit rate and predictive value.
